CUSTOM_ROLES.name: Administrator
CUSTOM_ROLES.description: Full system governance across all plant modules, workspaces, security settings, and user role definitions.

CUSTOM_ROLES.name: Manager
CUSTOM_ROLES.description: Plant & department management with full operational edit rights and report generation, without core system security overrides.

CUSTOM_ROLES.name: Technician
CUSTOM_ROLES.description: Field execution access to view assets and spare parts, log/update breakdowns, and execute preventive maintenance work orders.

CUSTOM_ROLES.name: Viewer
CUSTOM_ROLES.description: Read-only audit and executive visibility into dashboards, asset registers, and published reports without edit capability.
